packageRules.description: Hold typescript (aliased to TS6 for vue-tsc) below v7 until vue-tsc supports TS 7.1 API — see vuejs/language-tools#6124 and https://devblogs.microsoft.com/typescript/announcing-typescript-7-0/#typescript-and-embedded-languages — remove when fixed. @typescript/native is the TS7 Go tsc and is allowed to update.
